say: Thirteen big games today.
Barcelona have won all ten this season.
Betis have won all five at home.
Something has to give.

title.sub: eight more games on the board
say: Saturday's five biggest games, as card battles. Let's turn them over.

battles.story: Everton: unbeaten in the league this season. Chelsea: one win in their last nine league visits to Everton.
say: First battle, at half past twelve. Everton are unbeaten in the league, and Chelsea have won just one of their last nine league visits there.
But Chelsea score two and a half goals a game, and our numbers lean their way, forty percent to thirty-three.
Our call: Chelsea don't lose.

battles.story: Brentford: unbeaten in the league this season. Liverpool coach Andoni Iraola: no win in seven against Brentford.
say: Second battle, at three o'clock. Brentford are unbeaten in the league, and Liverpool coach Andoni Iraola has never beaten them in seven attempts.
Our numbers can't split them, thirty-six percent to thirty-seven. So we go with the story.
Our call: Brentford don't lose.

battles.story: Bayern: one defeat in their last 48 Bundesliga games. Leipzig: no points away from home this season.
say: Then Bayern and Leipzig. Bayern have lost one of their last forty-eight Bundesliga games, and Leipzig have no points away from home this season.
Our numbers give Bayern Munich seventy-two percent, and Leipzig just ten.
Our call: a Bayern Munich win.

battles.story: Newcastle: unbeaten at home this season. Aston Villa: three away wins in a row.
say: At the same time, Newcastle are unbeaten at home this season. Aston Villa have won their last three away games.
Our numbers are level, thirty-six to thirty-seven, but Villa arrive after a six–nil win in Europe.
Our call: Villa don't lose.

battles.story: Betis: five home games, five wins. Barcelona: ten games, ten wins. At least one run ends today.
say: And the big one. Betis have won all five at home, and Barcelona have won all ten this season. At least one of those runs ends today.
Our numbers back Barcelona, sixty-two percent, with over two expected goals.
Our call: Barcelona don't lose.
Also today, Manchester City go for seven league wins from seven, against Ipswich.
And Daniele De Rossi returns to Rome, as the Genoa coach.

cards.note: Atlético have won one of their last six against Espanyol.
Venezia: six Serie A games, six defeats.
Dortmund are unbeaten in the Bundesliga. Union are 16th.
City can make it seven league wins from seven.
PSG go for a fourth league win in a row.
Inter are top, but without captain Lautaro Martínez.
Daniele De Rossi returns to Rome as Genoa coach.
Rangers have won seven in a row in all competitions.

end.text: Five calls, judged on the result.
say: Five battles, five calls.
Which one are you watching? Tell us in the comments, and follow for the results.
